output: Thank you for raising this. It makes sense that per-seat pricing feels harder to justify as more schools come on board, since the cost grows with adoption. For occasional users, we offer lower-cost contributor and viewer seats, so the headteachers who only need to check progress or make occasional updates don't have to be priced like daily power users. We can also use multi-year terms, which can cap the annual increase. To show what this looks like for you, [PLACEHOLDER] pricing example: three-year cost for a company with mostly contributor seats. I'd be glad to send a three-year cost model at your expected user mix, with the renewal cap options side by side, so you can compare them directly.
